user.title: Start Coway Local
user.description: This integration hosts the fan’s local services. Use a reserved LAN IPv4 address reachable by the fan. After setup, choose Configure → Add fan. Tested with AP-1022K only.

error.invalid_server: Enter a reachable IPv4 address, three different ports (1024–65535), and an HTTPS provisioning URL.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Coway Local server is needed. Use Configure to add another fan.

add_fan.title: Add a fan
add_fan.description: Enter the serial number printed on the AP-1022K label. Keep the Coway app closed during setup.

pairing.title: Provision {name}
pairing.description:
[Open Bluetooth setup]({setup_url}) in a **new Chrome tab** on a nearby Mac or Android device. Enter Wi-Fi credentials there. This link expires in 15 minutes.

After the fan reports connected, return here and select Submit. Home Assistant will verify the authenticated MQTT connection.

server.title: Server settings
server.description: Changing the advertised address or ports requires provisioning existing fans again. Reserve the host’s LAN address before setup. Changing settings restarts this integration.

error.invalid_server: Enter a reachable IPv4 address, three different ports (1024–65535), and an HTTPS provisioning URL.
error.cannot_start_pairing: The local service is unavailable or there are too many active setup attempts.
error.invalid_serial: Enter the serial number from the fan’s label (6–32 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores).
error.not_connected: No authenticated connection yet. Finish Bluetooth setup, wait for the fan to connect, then submit again.

abort.pairing_expired: Setup expired. Choose Add fan to create a new link.
